description:
OCR lost from search when image is rotated

After rotating an image that has ocr text in it, it can't be found via ocr search anymore. The text is still shown visually.

tests_added: media.service.spec.ts: should keep the ocr search text if the edits have no crop
media.service.spec.ts: should tokenize the ocr search text inside the crop
